questions.explanation: 考查动词辨析。下文提到老奶奶拿出米袋子（bag of rice）以及“feed the birds”，可知作者总是看到这位老奶奶在“喂”鸽子。see sb doing sth表示看到某人正在做某事。
questions.supplement:
A(feeding)：语境句：The mother is feeding her baby with a silver spoon. 固定搭配：feed on, feed sb with sth
B(pursuing)：语境句：He is pursuing his dream of becoming a professional athlete. 固定搭配：pursue a goal, pursue a career
C(training)：语境句：She is training her dog to fetch the newspaper. 固定搭配：train sb to do sth, physical training
D(collecting)：语境句：He has been collecting rare stamps since he was a child. 固定搭配：collect data, collect information

questions.explanation: 考查名词辨析。前文提到“10 to 15”，这是一个具体的数字，表示鸽子的数量大约是10到15只。in number是固定介词短语，意为“在数量上”。
questions.supplement:
A(age)：语境句：Children of the same age tend to share similar interests. 固定搭配：at the age of, come of age
B(size)：语境句：The shoes are available in various sizes. 固定搭配：in size, of all sizes
C(weight)：语境句：She is trying to lose weight by exercising regularly. 固定搭配：lose weight, put on weight
D(number)：语境句：The birds, small in number, are strictly protected. 固定搭配：in number, a number of

questions.explanation: 考查名词辨析。鸽子聚集得非常迅速，甚至在老奶奶还没来得及（还没有机会）把米袋子从手提包里拿出来之前，它们就围拢过来了。have a chance to do sth意为“有机会/来得及做某事”。
questions.supplement:
A(wish)：语境句：Her greatest wish is to travel around the world. 固定搭配：make a wish, wish for
B(chance)：语境句：I didn't have a chance to say goodbye to him. 固定搭配：have a chance to do, by chance
C(plan)：语境句：They have a plan to expand their business globally. 固定搭配：make a plan, carry out a plan
D(reason)：语境句：Give me one good reason why I should believe you. 固定搭配：for the reason that, the reason for

questions.explanation: 考查名词辨析。前句提到“It was the same each day（每天都是如此）”，说明喂鸽子已经成为了她每天的“常规/日常惯例（routine）”。
questions.supplement:
A(job)：语境句：Finding a well-paid job in this city is quite challenging. 固定搭配：do a good job, apply for a job
B(project)：语境句：The students are working on a science project. 固定搭配：a research project, project management
C(routine)：语境句：Exercising every morning is part of my daily routine. 固定搭配：daily routine, break the routine
D(dream)：语境句：He finally realized his dream of becoming a pilot. 固定搭配：realize a dream, chase one's dream

questions.explanation: 考查动词辨析。第一段开头提到“watch the sunset”，作者在海边看日落时，同时也在“观看（watching）”老奶奶喂鸽子。watch sb do sth表示观看某人做某事的整个过程。
questions.supplement:
A(watching)：语境句：I sat on the bench, watching the children play in the park. 固定搭配：watch out, watch over
B(helping)：语境句：She spent the afternoon helping her mother with the housework. 固定搭配：help sb out, help with sth
C(making)：语境句：The factory is making efforts to reduce pollution. 固定搭配：make efforts, make a decision
D(hearing)：语境句：I look forward to hearing from you soon. 固定搭配：hear from, hear of

questions.explanation: 考查名词辨析。老奶奶每天都做同样的事情，动作熟练且准确无误。precision（精确、严谨）体现了她作为日常习惯的一丝不苟，这种有条不紊的精准感让人觉得既平静（calming）又美好（beautiful）。
questions.supplement:
A(confidence)：语境句：She answered the interviewer's questions with great confidence. 固定搭配：with confidence, have confidence in
B(enthusiasm)：语境句：He showed boundless enthusiasm for the new project. 固定搭配：with enthusiasm, arouse enthusiasm
C(flexibility)：语境句：Yoga helps improve your physical flexibility. 固定搭配：flexibility of mind, work flexibility
D(precision)：语境句：The machine is capable of cutting metal with high precision. 固定搭配：with precision, mathematical precision

questions.explanation: 考查形容词辨析。因为老奶奶每天都在同一个地方喂鸽子，所以这是她“平常的、惯常的（usual）”地点。
questions.supplement:
A(original)：语境句：The original painting is preserved in the museum. 固定搭配：original intention, original design
B(parking)：语境句：It's hard to find a parking space in the city center. 固定搭配：parking lot, parking spot
C(hiding)：语境句：The cat was found in its secret hiding place. 固定搭配：hiding place, go into hiding
D(usual)：语境句：He sat in his usual chair by the window. 固定搭配：as usual, usual practice

questions.explanation: 考查动词辨析。根据后面的“to sit down”可知，老奶奶正“靠近/走向（approached）”长凳准备坐下。approach表示在空间上向某人或某物靠近。
questions.supplement:
A(repaired)：语境句：My car is being repaired at the garage. 固定搭配：repair the damage, beyond repair
B(approached)：语境句：As winter approached, the days grew shorter. 固定搭配：approach a problem, an approach to doing sth
C(shared)：语境句：He shared his food with the hungry homeless man. 固定搭配：share with, share an opinion
D(supported)：语境句：My family has always supported me in my studies. 固定搭配：support oneself, financial support

questions.explanation: 考查动词短语辨析。前文提到作者本来“坐在草地上（sitting on the grass）”，注意到老奶奶的项链掉了，自然是“站起来（got up）”去帮她捡。
questions.supplement:
A(slipped in)：语境句：He opened the door quietly and slipped in. 固定搭配：slip in, slip out
B(ran away)：语境句：The thief ran away when he heard the police siren. 固定搭配：run away from, run away with
C(got up)：语境句：I got up early this morning to catch the train. 固定搭配：get up, get up to
D(turned around)：语境句：She turned around and saw him standing behind her. 固定搭配：turn around, turn against

questions.explanation: 考查副词辨析。作者起身去捡项链，本意是想帮老奶奶，但是（However）还没等作者走到，鸽子就抢先去捡了。此处表示转折关系。
questions.supplement:
A(However)：语境句：He was sick; however, he still went to work. 固定搭配：However hard he tries (引导让步状语从句)
B(Afterwards)：语境句：We had dinner together and went to a movie afterwards. 固定搭配：shortly afterwards, soon afterwards
C(Gradually)：语境句：The weather gradually improved as spring arrived. 固定搭配：gradually fade, gradually increase
D(Fortunately)：语境句：Fortunately, no one was injured in the traffic accident. 固定搭配：fortunately for sb

questions.explanation: 考查名词辨析。前文提到鸽子的数量在10到15只左右，因此它们是一群。从这“群（group）”鸽子中飞出了一只捡起了项链。
questions.supplement:
A(sea)：语境句：The sun sank slowly into the sea. 固定搭配：at sea, by the sea
B(tree)：语境句：The children climbed up the apple tree in the garden. 固定搭配：plant a tree, family tree
C(pair)：语境句：I bought a new pair of shoes yesterday. 固定搭配：a pair of, in pairs
D(group)：语境句：A group of students are discussing the topic enthusiastically. 固定搭配：a group of, age group

questions.explanation: 考查动词辨析。本句的主语是“one of the pigeons（一只鸽子）”，它捡起项链后，自然是“飞（flew）”到长凳上并将其放在老奶奶的腿上。
questions.supplement:
A(walked)：语境句：They walked along the beach hand in hand. 固定搭配：walk away, walk out
B(stuck)：语境句：The car was stuck in the mud and couldn't move. 固定搭配：stick to, stick out
C(pointed)：语境句：He pointed to the building across the street. 固定搭配：point at, point out
D(flew)：语境句：The bird flapped its wings and flew away. 固定搭配：fly away, fly high

questions.explanation: 考查动词辨析。看到一只鸽子居然主动帮人捡回项链，作者感到极为惊奇，以至于“不敢相信自己的眼睛（couldn't believe my eyes）”，这是固定表达。
questions.supplement:
A(lift)：语境句：This box is too heavy for me to lift. 固定搭配：lift up, give sb a lift
B(cover)：语境句：The mountains were covered with snow. 固定搭配：cover up, be covered with
C(believe)：语境句：I can hardly believe my ears when I heard the news. 固定搭配：believe in, can't believe one's eyes
D(close)：语境句：Please close the window before you leave. 固定搭配：close to, close up

questions.explanation: 考查形容词辨析。不仅作者感到难以置信，老奶奶自己对鸽子的举动也感到非常“惊讶（surprised）”，所以她开心地独自笑了起来。
questions.supplement:
A(satisfied)：语境句：The teacher was highly satisfied with the student's progress. 固定搭配：be satisfied with, fully satisfied
B(surprised)：语境句：We were surprised to see him at the party. 固定搭配：be surprised at, be surprised to do
C(annoyed)：语境句：He was annoyed by the constant noise from next door. 固定搭配：be annoyed with, be annoyed at
D(frightened)：语境句：The little girl is frightened of the dark. 固定搭配：be frightened of, frightened to death

questions.explanation: 考查动词辨析。这温情的一幕结束后，作者的脸上“留着（left）”灿烂的笑容。be left with sth是固定结构，意为“被留下…… / 带着……”。
questions.supplement:
A(caught)：语境句：The thief was caught red-handed by the police. 固定搭配：be caught in the rain, catch up with
B(hit)：语境句：The town was completely hit by a severe storm. 固定搭配：hit it off, hit the road
C(left)：语境句：After paying all the bills, I was left with only a few dollars. 固定搭配：leave behind, be left with
D(met)：语境句：All the requirements must be met before graduation. 固定搭配：meet the needs, meet one's eyes

vocab_pack.definition_en: an area next to the sea
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文作表语（which was a seaside area），名词短语表示地点。
vocab_pack.example_en: The hotel is located in a beautiful seaside area.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家酒店位于一个美丽的海边区域。
vocab_pack.from_passage: which was a seaside area in Karachi.

vocab_pack.definition_en: an old woman, typically one who is senior in age
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文作宾语（the same elderly lady），名词短语，elderly 为形容词修饰 lady。
vocab_pack.example_en: An elderly lady was walking her dog in the park.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一位老妇人在公园里遛狗。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I would always see the same elderly lady feeding the pigeons.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give food to pigeons
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为现在分词短语（feeding the pigeons）作宾语补足语（see sb doing），表示看见她正在喂鸽子。原型动词短语 feed the pigeons。
vocab_pack.example_en: Tourists like to feed the pigeons in the square.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 游客们喜欢在广场上喂鸽子。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I would always see the same elderly lady feeding the pigeons.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to come together around someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为 would gather around，情态动词 would + 动词原形，表示过去习惯性动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: The students gathered around the teacher to hear the story.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学生们围在老师周围听故事。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The birds... would gather around her

vocab_pack.definition_en: in terms of quantity; used to indicate the number of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为 around 10 to 15 in number，介词短语作状语，修饰数量。常用于说明数量范围。
vocab_pack.example_en: The participants, about 50 in number, arrived on time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 参与者大约有50人，准时到达了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: usually around 10 to 15 in number

vocab_pack.term: have a chance to do sth
vocab_pack.definition_en: to have an opportunity to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为 before she even had a chance to take，一般过去时，had 是 have 的过去式，后接不定式 to take。
vocab_pack.example_en: I hope I have a chance to visit Paris one day.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我希望有一天有机会去巴黎。
vocab_pack.from_passage: before she even had a chance to take the bag of rice out

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: take the bag of rice out from
vocab_pack.definition_en: to remove something from a container or place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为 take the bag of rice out from her handbag，动词短语 take out，宾语插在中间（take sth out），介词 from 引出来源。注意 out 为副词。
vocab_pack.example_en: She took out a book from her backpack.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她从背包里拿出了一本书。
vocab_pack.from_passage: take the bag of rice out from her handbag

vocab_pack.definition_en: a regular or habitual part of someone's daily activities
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文作表语（was part of her routine），名词短语表示属关系。routine 是名词，意为“日常惯例”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Exercising in the morning is part of my daily routine.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 早上锻炼是我日常例行的一部分。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It was the same each day, part of her routine.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to carry out or do a specific piece of work
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 执行任务；完成一项工作
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为 watching her perform this ordinary task，感官动词 watch + 宾语 + 动词原形（不带 to 的不定式作宾补），perform 是动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: The robot can perform many difficult tasks automatically.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个机器人可以自动执行许多困难的任务。
vocab_pack.from_passage: watching her perform this ordinary task

vocab_pack.definition_en: in an exact and accurate manner
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文作状语修饰 perform，表示方式。such 是形容词强调 precision。
vocab_pack.example_en: He solved the math problem with great precision.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他以极高的精确度解出了这道数学题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: perform this ordinary task with such precision

vocab_pack.definition_en: making you feel calm and relaxed
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 令人平静的；使人放松的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 calming 与 beautiful 并列，作 find 后宾语补足语（find sth calming and beautiful），现在分词作形容词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The sound of waves is very calming after a long day.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 经过漫长的一天，海浪的声音非常令人平静。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was both calming and beautiful

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to single out a specific person or thing; special
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文修饰 evening（this particular evening），形容词作定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Is there any particular reason why you are late?
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你迟到有什么特别的原因吗？
vocab_pack.from_passage: On this particular evening

vocab_pack.definition_en: to reach a place, especially at the end of a journey
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为 arrived at her usual spot，一般过去时，arrived 是动词过去式，at 表示到达小地点。
vocab_pack.example_en: We arrived at the airport two hours early.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们提前两小时到达了机场。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the lady arrived at her usual spot

vocab_pack.definition_en: the typical or regular location where someone goes
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文作介词 at 的宾语（her usual spot），名词短语，usual 是形容词修饰 spot。
vocab_pack.example_en: Let's meet at our usual spot after class.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 下课后我们在老地方见。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the lady arrived at her usual spot

vocab_pack.definition_en: to come near or nearer to someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为 as she approached the bench，一般过去时，approach 是及物动词，直接接宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The cat approached me cautiously.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那只猫小心翼翼地靠近我。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as she approached the bench

vocab_pack.definition_en: to drop or descend to the surface of the earth
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为 her necklace fell to the ground，一般过去时，fell 是 fall 的过去式，to the ground 是介词短语表示结果。
vocab_pack.example_en: The leaves fall to the ground in autumn.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 秋天叶子落到地上。
vocab_pack.from_passage: her necklace fell to the ground

vocab_pack.definition_en: to rest with the body supported by something (like a chair or ground)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为 I was sitting on the grass，过去进行时，表示当时正在进行的动作。sit on 是固定搭配，on 表示表面接触。
vocab_pack.example_en: The children are sitting on the floor playing games.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 孩子们正坐在地板上玩游戏。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was sitting on the grass nearby

vocab_pack.definition_en: to stay in a place until someone or something arrives or happens
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为 waiting for the sun to set，现在分词短语作状语，表示伴随。wait for 是固定搭配，后接等待的对象。
vocab_pack.example_en: She waited for the bus at the stop for 20 minutes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在车站等了20分钟的公交车。
vocab_pack.from_passage: waiting for the sun to set

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become aware of something by seeing or hearing; to observe that...
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 Noticing that 为现在分词短语作状语，逻辑主语为 I。that 引导名词性从句作 notice 的宾语。注意句首首字母大写。
vocab_pack.example_en: Noticing that the door was open, he checked the room.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 注意到门开着，他检查了房间。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Noticing that, I got up to get it back for her.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to rise from a sitting or lying position; stand up
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为 I got up，一般过去时，got 是 get 的过去式，up 是副词。
vocab_pack.example_en: He got up from his chair to greet the guests.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他从椅子上站起来迎接客人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I got up to get it back for her.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to retrieve something that was lost or taken away
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文为 get it back，动词短语 get back 中宾语 it 插在中间。get 是原形（to 不定式的一部分），back 是副词。
vocab_pack.example_en: I need to get my book back from Jane.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我需要从简那里拿回我的书。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to get it back for her

vocab_pack.definition_en: to arrive at or get to a place; to touch or grasp something by stretching
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 before I reached it，一般过去时，reached 是过去式，it 指代 necklace。
vocab_pack.example_en: We reached the top of the mountain after a long climb.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 经过长时间的攀登，我们到达了山顶。
vocab_pack.from_passage: before I reached it

vocab_pack.definition_en: to take hold of something and lift it up from a surface
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 one of the pigeons... picked up the necklace，一般过去时，picked up 是短语动词，宾语放在 up 之后。
vocab_pack.example_en: She picked up the coin from the ground.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她从地上捡起了硬币。
vocab_pack.from_passage: one of the pigeons from the group picked up the necklace

vocab_pack.definition_en: to move through the air to a particular place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 flew to the bench，一般过去时，flew 是 fly 的过去式，to 表示方向。
vocab_pack.example_en: The bird flew to the tree and sang.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那只鸟飞到树上唱歌。
vocab_pack.from_passage: flew to the bench

vocab_pack.definition_en: to let something fall onto a surface or object
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 dropped it on her lap，一般过去时，dropped 是 drop 的过去式，on 表示接触面。宾语 it 插在中间。
vocab_pack.example_en: Be careful not to drop the glass on the floor.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 小心别把玻璃杯掉在地上。
vocab_pack.from_passage: dropped it on her lap

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be shocked or surprised by what one sees, often used in negative
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 I couldn't believe my eyes，一般过去时，couldn't 是 can't 的过去式，my eyes 是固定搭配。
vocab_pack.example_en: When I saw the beautiful scenery, I couldn't believe my eyes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 当我看到那美丽的景色时，简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I couldn't believe my eyes.

vocab_pack.definition_en: feeling or showing astonishment because something unexpected happens
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 The old lady, also surprised, began laughing...，形容词作插入语，表示主语的状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: She was surprised to see her old friend at the party.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在派对上看到老朋友很惊讶。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The old lady, also surprised, began laughing quietly to herself.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to start an action or activity (followed by gerund)
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 开始做某事（后接动名词）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 began laughing，一般过去时，began 是 begin 的过去式，laughing 是动名词作宾语。begin 后也可接不定式，此处用动名词强调动作的持续。
vocab_pack.example_en: He began studying English when he was five.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他五岁时开始学习英语。
vocab_pack.from_passage: began laughing quietly to herself

vocab_pack.definition_en: to laugh silently or quietly, not intending others to hear
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 laughing quietly to herself，动名词短语作 began 的宾语。to oneself 表示“独自地、不出声地”。
vocab_pack.example_en: He read the funny email and laughed to himself.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他读了那封有趣的邮件，暗自笑了起来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: laughing quietly to herself

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have something remaining after an event; to be given something as a result
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 I was left with a huge smile，被动语态，was left 是 leave 的过去分词形式，with 引出剩余的内容。
vocab_pack.example_en: After the fire, the family was left with nothing.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 火灾后，这家人一无所有。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was left with a huge smile on my face

vocab_pack.definition_en: to return to a previous activity, place, or state
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 回到（某活动/状态）；继续做某件事
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文 went back to watching the sunset，一般过去时，went 是 go 的过去式，back to 后接动名词表示回到该活动。
vocab_pack.example_en: After a short break, he went back to working on his project.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 短暂休息后，他继续投入到他的项目中。
vocab_pack.from_passage: happily went back to watching the sunset

section_2_word_form.passage:
In 2010, the UN Department of Global Communications instituted language days for each of the organization's six official languages. The goal was two-fold: [56] (celebrate) cultural diversity as well as to promote the equal use of all six [57] (tongue).
Language is the carrier of communication, the bridge of interaction between nations, [58] the bond of understanding among civilizations. At the same time, a language and its individual [59] (write) forms make up the "soul" of a nation's cultural tradition. Every language is worthy of respect and should [60] (treat) equally.
The UN Chinese Language Day not only provides a unique platform [61] the world to better understand China, but also [62] (promote) language and cultural exchanges in the world.
Today, more than 70 countries have included the Chinese language in their education systems. Chinese plays an increasingly important role in [63] (improve) communication and cooperation between China and [64] rest of the world. As more and more foreigners start to study the Chinese language and experience Chinese culture, the world will have a better understanding of China and its rich history, its hard-working people, its development through [65] (innovate), and its inclusiveness. China, on its part, will also embrace (拥抱) the world with greater openness and make new contributions to the international community.

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。根据连词as well as后面的to promote可知，此处需要与to promote保持结构平行，因此填动词不定式to celebrate，与to promote并列作表语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to celebrate)：语境句：The town held a grand parade to celebrate its anniversary. 固定搭配：celebrate a festival, celebrate a victory。原词celebrate其它变形：celebration(n.), celebratory(adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查名词复数。根据前面的six可知，此处指联合国的六种官方“语言”，tongue作“语言”解时为可数名词，需用复数形式tongues。
questions.supplement: 正确形(tongues)：语境句：The message was translated into multiple native tongues. 固定搭配：mother tongue, slip of the tongue。原词tongue其它变形：tongue-tied(adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查连词。分析句子结构可知，“the carrier...”，“the bridge...”，与“the bond...”这三部分成分相同，构成三者的并列关系，故在最后一项前填并列连词and。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and)：语境句：He enjoys reading books, listening to music, and watching movies. 固定搭配：both A and B, between A and B。原词and其它无变形。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词作定语。此处修饰名词forms（形式），意为“书面形式”。write（写）与forms之间是被动关系，故用过去分词written作前置定语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(written)：语境句：The contract requires written consent from both parties. 固定搭配：written exam, written permission。原词write其它变形：writer(n.), writing(n.), wrote(v.过去式)

questions.explanation: 考查被动语态。主语Every language与treat之间是被动关系（被对待），且空前有情态动词should，故填be treated构成情态动词的被动语态。
questions.supplement: 正确形(be treated)：语境句：All customers should be treated with equal respect. 固定搭配：be treated as, treat sb well。原词treat其它变形：treatment(n.)

questions.explanation: 考查介词。句意为联合国中文日为世界更好地了解中国提供了一个独特的平台。provide a platform for sb to do sth为常见搭配，意为“为某人做某事提供平台”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(for)：语境句：This event serves as a great opportunity for students to show their talents. 固定搭配：provide sth for sb, it is adj for sb to do sth。原词for其它无变形。

questions.explanation: 考查主谓一致与时态。not only... but also...连接两个并列谓语。前面为provides（一般现在时，第三人称单数），因此but also后面也应保持时态和人称一致，填promotes。
questions.supplement: 正确形(promotes)：语境句：Regular exercise promotes physical and mental well-being. 固定搭配：promote growth, promote communication。原词promote其它变形：promotion(n.), promoter(n.)

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。介词in后需接动名词形式作宾语，且improve与随后的宾语communication是动宾关系，故填improving。
questions.supplement: 正确形(improving)：语境句：She is dedicated to improving her English speaking skills. 固定搭配：play a role in improving, be aimed at improving。原词improve其它变形：improvement(n.), improved(adj.)

questions.explanation: 考查冠词。the rest of... 为固定冠词搭配，意为“剩余的……/ 其余的……”。此处the rest of the world特指“世界上的其余国家/地区”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(the)：语境句：I have finished half of the task, and will do the rest tomorrow. 固定搭配：the rest of, for the rest of one's life。原词the其它无变形。

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。介词through后需接名词作其宾语。所给词innovate（动词，创新）的名词形式为innovation，此处表示中国通过“创新”取得的发展。
questions.supplement: 正确形(innovation)：语境句：Technological innovation is the driving force behind economic growth. 固定搭配：technological innovation, encourage innovation。原词innovate其它变形：innovative(adj.), innovator(n.)

vocab_pack.definition_en: to set up or establish (something, typically an institution or system)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去式，用于描述2010年联合国部门设立了语言日。
vocab_pack.example_en: The government instituted a new policy to reduce pollution.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 政府制定了一项新政策来减少污染。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the UN Department of Global Communications instituted language days

vocab_pack.definition_en: having two parts or aspects; double
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作表语，描述 goal 的特征，意为『有两个方面』。
vocab_pack.example_en: The benefits of the program are two-fold: economic and social.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个项目的好处是双重的：经济方面和社会方面。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The goal was two-fold

vocab_pack.definition_en: to mark (a special occasion) with festivities; to praise publicly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式，与 to 连用作目的状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: We celebrate the festival with great enthusiasm every year.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们每年都满怀热情地庆祝这个节日。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to celebrate cultural diversity

vocab_pack.definition_en: the existence of a variety of cultural groups within a society
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词 celebrate 的宾语，为不可数名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Schools should promote cultural diversity through exchange programs.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学校应通过交流项目促进文化多样性。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to celebrate cultural diversity

vocab_pack.definition_en: to support or encourage the progress, existence, or acceptance of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时第三人称单数，主语 the UN Chinese Language Day。
vocab_pack.example_en: Regular exercise promotes good health.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 定期锻炼促进身体健康。
vocab_pack.from_passage: but also promotes language and cultural exchanges

vocab_pack.definition_en: the fair and impartial use of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作 promote 的宾语，equal 为形容词修饰 use。
vocab_pack.example_en: The policy ensures equal use of resources among all departments.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该政策确保所有部门平等使用资源。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to promote the equal use of all six tongues

vocab_pack.definition_en: a language, especially one spoken by a particular group
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式，与 six 连用，指六种官方语言。
vocab_pack.example_en: He spoke in a foreign tongue that I could not understand.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他用一种我听不懂的外语讲话。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the equal use of all six tongues

vocab_pack.definition_en: the representation of a language in writing
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式，与 its individual 搭配，作主语，谓语 make up。
vocab_pack.example_en: The written form of Chinese characters is very artistic.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 汉字的书写形式非常具有艺术性。
vocab_pack.from_passage: its individual written forms

vocab_pack.definition_en: to constitute or form (something)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语为复数名词短语 written forms，make 用原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: Women make up more than half of the workforce in this industry.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在这个行业中，女性占劳动力的一半以上。
vocab_pack.from_passage: make up the 'soul' of a nation's cultural tradition

vocab_pack.definition_en: to deserve something (respect, praise, attention, etc.)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: be 动词用 is，第三人称单数，后接名词 respect。
vocab_pack.example_en: His hard work is worthy of admiration.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的勤奋值得钦佩。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Every language is worthy of respect

vocab_pack.definition_en: to treat someone or something in a fair and impartial manner
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态，should be treated 为情态动词被动语态，treated 为过去分词；equally 为副词修饰 treated。
vocab_pack.example_en: All employees should be treated equally regardless of their background.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 所有员工都应受到平等对待，无论其背景如何。
vocab_pack.from_passage: should be treated equally

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give someone an opportunity or a place for a particular activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时第三人称单数 provides，后接宾语 a unique platform，再接 for 引导的目的。
vocab_pack.example_en: The conference provides a platform for young scientists to share their research.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这次会议为年轻科学家提供了一个分享研究的平台。
vocab_pack.from_passage: provides a unique platform for the world to better understand China

vocab_pack.definition_en: to understand something more deeply or clearly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: better 为副词修饰动词 understand，不定式短语作目的状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: We need to better understand the needs of our customers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们需要更好地理解客户的需求。
vocab_pack.from_passage: for the world to better understand China

vocab_pack.definition_en: activities involving the exchange of languages and cultures between groups
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式，作 promotes 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The program fosters language and cultural exchanges between universities.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该项目促进大学之间的语言文化交流。
vocab_pack.from_passage: promotes language and cultural exchanges in the world

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make something part of something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时 have included，included 为过去分词；后接介词 in 引出整体。
vocab_pack.example_en: The school has included Chinese in its curriculum.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这所学校已将中文纳入其课程。
vocab_pack.from_passage: have included the Chinese language in their education systems

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: plays an increasingly important role in
vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a part or function in something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时第三人称单数 plays，后接 an increasingly important role，再接 in。
vocab_pack.example_en: Technology plays a crucial role in modern education.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 技术在现代教育中发挥着关键作用。
vocab_pack.from_passage: plays an increasingly important role in improving communication and cooperation

vocab_pack.definition_en: becoming more important over time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词 increasingly 修饰形容词 important，共同修饰名词 role。
vocab_pack.example_en: Environmental protection is becoming increasingly important.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 环境保护变得越来越重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: plays an increasingly important role

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make communication better or more effective
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动名词短语，作介词 in 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Regular team meetings help improve communication among members.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 定期的团队会议有助于改善成员之间的沟通。
vocab_pack.from_passage: in improving communication and cooperation

vocab_pack.definition_en: all other countries or people besides those already mentioned
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 世界其他地区；其他国家
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词 between...and... 中的宾语部分，为固定短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: China is strengthening ties with the rest of the world.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 中国正在加强与世界其他地区的联系。
vocab_pack.from_passage: between China and the rest of the world

vocab_pack.definition_en: to begin learning or examining something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语为复数 foreigners，start 用原形，后接不定式 to study。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many students start to study English in elementary school.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多学生在小学开始学习英语。
vocab_pack.from_passage: start to study the Chinese language

vocab_pack.definition_en: to encounter, undergo, or feel something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式，与 start to study 并列作谓语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Traveling allows you to experience different cultures firsthand.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 旅行让你亲身体验不同的文化。
vocab_pack.from_passage: experience Chinese culture

vocab_pack.definition_en: to comprehend something more fully
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 将来时 will have，have 为原形，后接名词短语 a better understanding of。
vocab_pack.example_en: After the lecture, I had a better understanding of the topic.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 讲座之后，我对这个主题有了更好的理解。
vocab_pack.from_passage: will have a better understanding of China

vocab_pack.definition_en: a history filled with important events and cultural wealth
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 作介词 of 的宾语，与 it's 所有格连用。
vocab_pack.example_en: The museum showcases the country's rich history.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个博物馆展示了该国丰富的历史。
vocab_pack.from_passage: its rich history

vocab_pack.definition_en: progress achieved by introducing new ideas or methods
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词 through 引导方式状语，修饰 development，整体为名词短语作宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The company emphasizes development through innovation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家公司强调通过创新发展。
vocab_pack.from_passage: its development through innovation

vocab_pack.definition_en: a new idea, method, or device; the process of introducing new things
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不可数名词，作介词 through 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Innovation is key to staying competitive in the market.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 创新是在市场中保持竞争力的关键。
vocab_pack.from_passage: development through innovation

vocab_pack.definition_en: the quality of including all people, regardless of differences
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不可数名词，作介词 of 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The school promotes inclusiveness by accepting students from diverse backgrounds.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这所学校通过接受来自不同背景的学生来促进包容性。
vocab_pack.from_passage: its inclusiveness

vocab_pack.definition_en: from the side or perspective of someone; as far as someone is concerned
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 插入语，its 指代 China，表示『在中国方面』。
vocab_pack.example_en: The team, on its part, has done everything possible to win.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 就团队而言，他们已经尽了一切可能去赢得胜利。
vocab_pack.from_passage: China, on its part, will also embrace the world

vocab_pack.definition_en: to accept something willingly and enthusiastically
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 将来时 will 后接动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: We should embrace new technologies to improve our lives.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应该拥抱新技术来改善我们的生活。
vocab_pack.from_passage: will also embrace the world with greater openness

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a more open, transparent, and accepting manner
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作方式状语，修饰 embrace。
vocab_pack.example_en: The country welcomed foreign investment with greater openness.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该国以更大的开放度欢迎外国投资。
vocab_pack.from_passage: embrace the world with greater openness

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give help, money, effort, etc. to something in order to achieve something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 将来时 will 后接动词原形 make，new 为形容词修饰 contributions，to 引出对象。
vocab_pack.example_en: Scientists make contributions to medical research every day.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 科学家们每天都在为医学研究做出贡献。
vocab_pack.from_passage: make new contributions to the international community
